The orange tube rests passively on the surface, unconnected to the heart or tool, with no visible movement or attachment.
rationale: The indentation on the heart and motion lines suggest physical contact between heart and tool, though the exact nature (cutting, piercing, clamping) is ambiguous due to stylization.

limitations: Stylization obscures whether the tool is damaging, healing, or neutral; no contextual cues confirm intent.
